Select: canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source: metabolism table. Join: compound_records (substrate_record_id) for substrate_compound_name; compound_records (drug_record_id) for parent_compound_name; compound_structures (molregno from substrate_record_id) for canonical_smiles. Filter: organism = 'Callithrix jacchus'. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, substrate_compound_name ASC, parent_compound_name ASC, met_conversion ASC, pathway_key ASC, organism ASC, enzyme_name ASC. Limit: 200.
